title: docs(skills): the registerHook example names the app's onEnable export, and the refusal-list teaching names its routes, the /data bound and its section

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu5aGSp1oEmXTAmjuazY7oxd)_

Fixes #38161
Fixes #37642

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：照数据技能写钩子的开发者和 AI 会读到正确的注册位置：示例注释原来写「放在插件的 onEnable 里」，插件根本没有这个方法，照写的钩子永远不会注册；现在写明放在应用配置导出的 onEnable 里，插件则在启动方法里经服务拿引擎注册。拒绝清单一段还补了两点：数据接口会把返回消息截在 500 字，长清单的最后一行在那里会被截掉；哪些接口返回拒绝清单也点了名。动作技能页的「规则在那里」改成点名所指的章节。运行时行为不变。
- 为什么：属于「AI 照技能写出能跑的元数据」。照错误注释写的钩子不跑也不报错，是静默失效。
- 出错会怎样：只是技能文字，写错了是教错，可直接撤回；两个文件都在字数上限，新增靠删同文件里的重复说法来付，没有事实被删掉。
- 要你做的：座位审核和合同审核通过后，技能目录需你批准合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, Registration Methods, method 2 (#38161): the comment `// in your plugin's onEnable()` named a method no kernel plugin has. It now reads `// in the app's onEnable export (objectstack.config.ts). A kernel plugin has no ctx.ql: from start(ctx), ctx.getService('objectql').registerHook(…)`, and the heading's "the plugin escape hatch" became "the `onEnable` escape hatch".
  - `packages/core/src/types.ts:155` `Plugin` has `init` / `start?` / `destroy?` and no `onEnable`; `PluginContext` (:16) has `getService` (:37) and no `ql`.
  - `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:1795-1834` resolves the bundle's `onEnable` and calls it with `hostContext = { ...ctx, ql, logger, drivers }`; `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:1319` declares `onEnable` on the stack.
  - `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:932` registers the engine as service `objectql`; `engine.ts:715` is `registerHook`; `AppPlugin.start` itself reads `ctx.getService('objectql')` (`app-plugin.ts:1464`).
- Same file, Declared refusals, the several-reasons bullet (#37642 N2, N5): "the HTTP doors answer `details.refusals`" became: `/data` cuts `userMessage` (a single sentence's too) at 500 characters, so a long list loses its closing line there; `/data` and `/actions` answer `details.refusals: [{ reason, message }]` uncut (MCP tools relay the lines as text).
  - Bound: `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts:55` `CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX = 500`, applied to a declared `userMessage` by `mapDataError` → `withDeclaredUserMessage` → `boundedDeclaredUserMessage` (:568-703); the list stays whole (:609-620). `/actions` uses the unbounded `declaredUserMessage` (`thrown-http-error.ts:408`, via `actions-door-answer.ts:415-438`).
  - Routes: `/data` `withDeclaredRefusalLines` (`data-error-classification.ts:622`); `/actions` `action-dispatch.ts:957` → `thrown-http-error.ts:396-404`; MCP `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:1474-1498` appends the lines as text.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, Refusing by code (#37642 N4): "(rules there)" named no place; it now ends "(Declared refusals)", the last segment of the same paragraph's pointer "objectstack-data → Lifecycle Hooks → Declared refusals". "closed by" became "then" to pay the byte.
- `.changeset/38161-skills-hook-registration-refusal-pointers.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

**Paid by cuts in `data-hooks.md`** (each fact still in the file): the Error-handling row's "`onError` defaults to `'abort'` unconditionally" (the row keeps "Also aborts by default"); the repeated transition expression → "as above" (the code block above carries it); the `after*` bullet's "(`record` is that row's real state, not the bare payload)" (the section's bold lead says it); Gotcha 1's one-line `findOne` block → "re-query it by `ctx.result.id`, as the example below does" (the copy-paste example and Query shape carry the line); the copy-paste intro's "(a lookup FK that is **not** in the partial patch)" (Gotcha 1 says it); the `ctx.log` bullet's "two independent causes: (1) … (2)" scaffolding.

**Skills readings** (lines / bytes, merge base 4f7aa88a → head):

| | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `data-hooks.md` | 856 / 40477 | 851 / 40480 |
| `actions.md` | 268 / 15670 | 268 / 15671 |
| all `skills/**/SKILL.md`, lines | 4953 | 4953 |
| whole `skills/` tree, bytes | 1224868 | 1224872 |

Both files stay at their token ceilings (10120, 3918); no ceiling line changed.

The `skills/**` edits were written by isolated sub-agents at the contract-review tier; `node scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` on their transcripts: `PASS — 4 assistant turn(s)` (actions.md) and `PASS — 54 assistant turn(s)` (data-hooks.md), every one served at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER. Not traced: whether the dispatcher's own `/data` twin (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`) carries the same cut and list, so the text names only `/data` and `/actions`.

## Acceptance notes

- The 4xx `error` text on `/data` is cut at the same 500 characters (`data-error-classification.ts:1679`); not added, it did not fit the budget and the card asks for `userMessage`.
- A throw that leaves the dispatcher's `dispatch()` exits through `errorResponseBase` (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:711`), where no `refusals` handling was seen; that is why the page does not promise the list on the dispatcher's other routes. Read only, not filed.

## Verification

Read first: `data-hooks.md` method 2 code block; the several-reasons bullet under Declared refusals; the last sentence of "Refusing by code" in `actions.md`.
